about.en: ALI (Artificial Liquid Intelligence) is the utility token of the AI Protocol created by Alethea AI, the team behind the intelligent-NFT (iNFT) standard for NFTs with embedded AI characters. It is used to create, stake on and pay for AI agents and iNFTs in that ecosystem. ALI is an ERC-20 on Ethereum (0x6B0b3a982b4634aC68dD83a4DBF02311cE324181) with deployments on Base, Polygon, Solana and Cronos.
